games.name: Invariant Gallery
games.definingDecision: Construct a conjunction of linear inequalities that contains every initial state, excludes every forbidden state and is preserved by every enabled program transition, including currently unreachable states inside the chosen region.
games.transitionSignature: Editing a coefficient/bound changes a region of integer states. Certification checks initial inclusion, safety exclusion and one-step inductive closure under actual guarded transitions; a fitted boundary can fail because it admits a state whose successor escapes.

nearestExisting.difference: Separation classifies fixed labeled points by one line/margin; invariance must also quantify over every admitted state and preserve the region through all enabled updates, requiring multiple inequalities.
Temporal forecasts calculate given-graph satisfaction sets; this synthesizes a compact arithmetic invariant and must reject admitted unreachable states that violate induction.
Overflow witnesses find one input trace; an inductive invariant proves exclusion for all allowed traces.

finiteStudies: A preserved x−y bound beats a boundary fitted only to examples.
Two inequalities exclude a corner while retaining all initial states.
Unequal increments require the correct slope and a guarded upper bound.
games.controls: Select inequality, integer coefficient/bound controls, add/remove a limited conjunct, Certify. Integer state-plane drawing, transition arrows/guards and counterexample trace; native sliders/buttons/touch.
games.failureChallenge: Three failed invariants lose; feedback identifies missing initial state, admitted forbidden state, or exact allowed transition leaving the region. Any valid bounded-form invariant accepted.
